senses.text: to move in (to a new home)
senses.example: De flyttede ind i lejligheden i går.
senses.example_translation: They moved into the apartment yesterday.

senses.example: Jeg sagde forkert, men jeg rettede mig hurtigt.
senses.example_translation: I said the wrong thing, but I quickly corrected myself.

senses.example: Han kørte over for rødt i morges.
senses.example_translation: He ran a red light this morning.

senses.example: Han hængte sig i garagen.
senses.example_translation: He hanged himself in the garage.

senses.example: Hun hænger sig altid i små detaljer.
senses.example_translation: She always gets hung up on small details.

senses.example: Hun kigger sig omkring i det nye hus.
senses.example_translation: She looks around the new house.

senses.example: Med hensyn til maden er jeg meget tilfreds.
senses.example_translation: As for the food, I am very satisfied.

senses.example: Jeg varmer mig foran pejsen.
senses.example_translation: I warm myself in front of the fireplace.

senses.example: Vi fokuserer på de vigtigste opgaver i dag.
senses.example_translation: We focus on the most important tasks today.

senses.example: Jeg beskæftiger mig med gamle bøger i min fritid.
senses.example_translation: In my spare time I occupy myself with old books.

senses.example: Mine bedsteforældre stammer fra Polen.
senses.example_translation: My grandparents come from Poland.

senses.example: Lægen tester for bakterier i prøven.
senses.example_translation: The doctor tests for bacteria in the sample.

senses.example: Han bøjede sig for at tage nøglen op.
senses.example_translation: He bent down to pick up the key.

senses.example: De to grupper forenede sig for at blive stærkere.
senses.example_translation: The two groups united to become stronger.

senses.example: Vi kom i gang med projektet i går.
senses.example_translation: We got started on the project yesterday.

senses.example: Du skal bare være dig selv til festen.
senses.example_translation: You just have to be yourself at the party.

senses.example: Vi kommer sammen med naboerne hver fredag.
senses.example_translation: We get together with the neighbors every Friday.

senses.example: Jeg arbejder over hver dag i denne uge.
senses.example_translation: I'm working overtime every day this week.

senses.example: De tog plads ved bordet og ventede på maden.
senses.example_translation: They took a seat at the table and waited for the food.

senses.example: Han hørte op med at ryge sidste år.
senses.example_translation: He quit smoking last year.

senses.example: Regnen hørte op i morges.
senses.example_translation: The rain stopped this morning.

senses.example: Hun trækker på sin erfaring fra tidligere job.
senses.example_translation: She draws on her experience from previous jobs.

senses.example: Hun sikrede sig en god plads til koncerten.
senses.example_translation: She secured a good seat for the concert.

senses.example: Børnene hjælper til i haven om søndagen.
senses.example_translation: The children help out in the garden on Sundays.

senses.example: Jeg spørger mig selv, om det er en god idé.
senses.example_translation: I wonder if this is a good idea.

senses.example: Hun længes efter sin familie i hjemlandet.
senses.example_translation: She longs for her family in her home country.

senses.example: Hun tager imod gæster hele dagen.
senses.example_translation: She receives guests throughout the day.

senses.example: Opgaven består i at finde fejlene i teksten.
senses.example_translation: The task consists in finding the errors in the text.

senses.example: Husk på at låse døren når du går.
senses.example_translation: Remember to lock the door when you leave.

senses.example: Jeg taler i telefon med min mor hver aften.
senses.example_translation: I talk to my mother on the phone every evening.

senses.example: Vi spiser til aften klokken seks.
senses.example_translation: We have dinner at six o'clock.

senses.example: Alle studerende har adgang til bibliotekets online databaser.
senses.example_translation: All students have access to the library's online databases.

senses.example: Jeg kigger forbi i morgen eftermiddag.
senses.example_translation: I'll stop by tomorrow afternoon.

senses.example: Han udtrykker sig altid meget klart.
senses.example_translation: He always expresses himself very clearly.

senses.example: Det gamle hus brændte ned i nat.
senses.example_translation: The old house burned down last night.

senses.example: Jeg hører radio hver morgen.
senses.example_translation: I listen to the radio every morning.

senses.example: Hun rører i suppen med en ske.
senses.example_translation: She stirs the soup with a spoon.

senses.example: Hun insisterede på at betale for maden.
senses.example_translation: She insisted on paying for the food.

senses.example: Hele systemet styrtede ned.
senses.example_translation: The whole system crashed.

senses.example: Hun lagde på uden at sige farvel.
senses.example_translation: She hung up without saying goodbye.

senses.example: Hun gik foran os hele vejen til stationen.
senses.example_translation: She walked in front of us all the way to the station.

senses.example: Lederen bør gå foran og vise, hvordan man gør.
senses.example_translation: The leader should lead by example and show how to do it.

senses.example: Mange danskere stemmer for den nye lov.
senses.example_translation: Many Danes are voting in favour of the new law.

senses.example: Hun sagde tak for gaven.
senses.example_translation: She said thank you for the gift.

senses.example: Hun sprang ud som homoseksuel for sine forældre.
senses.example_translation: She came out as gay to her parents.
